_comment: Everything that makes the world feel inhabited without changing a rule. Villagers are simulated on the server so every client sees the same person in the same place; dressing, life and sound are client-side decoration seeded from these numbers.

villagers._comment: How many wander a hub, and how they move. Slower than a player on purpose: a villager overtaking you reads as a race. keepAwayTiles holds them out of the plaza centre and off the three shop fronts, so nobody is ever standing between you and the kitchen door.

roster.name: Old Marta
lines: Mind the cauldron, it bites.
Sunwheat's thick in the Meadows this week.
I cooked here before you were a thought.

roster.name: Pip
lines: Did you see the glowcaps? Did you?
I'm not lost. I'm scouting.
Tavern pays better for the fancy ones.

roster.name: Brannoc
lines: Caves are cold. Bring something hot.
Rock salt keeps. Berries don't.
Good day for a walk, bad day for a climb.

roster.name: Sefa the Grocer
lines: Fresh today, cheap tomorrow.
Outfitter's got a bigger bag if you've the coin.
You look like you're carrying too much.

roster.name: Dorn
lines: Heat's everything. Timing's the rest.
Burnt three of those this morning.
Watch the bar, not the pan.

roster.name: Nell
lines: Somebody left a pot boiling. Again.
Mind how you go.
The well's sweeter than the stream.

roster.name: Hobb
lines: Cart's fixed. Mostly.
Long road from the Deep Forest.
Seen stranger things than you.

roster.name: Wren
lines: The crystals sing, if you're quiet.
I only cook by moonlight.
Chef thirty, one day. You watch.

hubProps._comment: Named decoration, out on the ring of the plaza rather than in the middle of it: the centre is where the game is played and where the camera sits. Every one of these is checked by the layout validator at startup - on a path, on a doorway, or within three tiles of a building or the cauldron and the server refuses to start.

dressing._comment: Scattered pack art. Seeded so every player sees the same shrub in the same place, and biased outward so the middle of a map stays clear to play in.

life._comment: Per-map particles. everyMs is how often one is emitted; 0 disables it. All of them draw from the same 200-particle pool as cooking, and cooking wins.

maps._comment: Chimney smoke over the kitchen roof.

dayNight._comment: A 20 minute loop applied to the ground only. Sprites, labels and the HUD keep their own colours, so nothing ever becomes unreadable - the floor simply turns from dawn through noon to dusk and a blue night.

sound._comment: Hooks only. Nothing here has to exist: a missing file leaves the cue silent, and the UI cues fall back to the synthesised blip the cooking chime already uses.
